units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 16:12">Targ. I Sam. XVI, 12</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 47:6">Targ. O. Gen. XLVII, 6</cite>, (v. <cite ref="U01800"><he>שֶׁפֶר</he></cite> ch.); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 16:5">Midr. Till. to Ps. XVI, 6</cite> (in Hebr. dict.) <he>על … נעשה לי ש׳</he> because I was content with my portion, it became beautiful to me; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 667:3">Yalk. ib. 667</cite> (corr. acc.).—

<cite ref="Kiddushin 31b:7">Kidd. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>בעינא גברא דש׳ כותך</he> I want a man as handsome as thou art; a. fr.—Pl. <he>שַׁפִּירִין</he>, <cite ref="U01762"><he>שַׁפִּירַיָּא</he></cite>, <cite ref="U00405"><he>שַׁפִּירֵי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 7:10">Targ. II Chr. VII, 10</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 84a:9">B. Mets. 84ᵃ</cite> <he>אנא</he> … <he>מש׳ ירושלם</he> I am one of the survivors of the handsome men of Jerusalem.
Ib. בני ש׳ כוותי children as good-looking as I am; a. fr.—Fem. שׁפִּירָא, שַׁפִּירְתָּא, שַׁפִּרְ׳.

<cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 12:1">Targ. O. Num. XII, 1</cite>; a. fr.—B. Mets. l. c. <he>דש׳ מינאי</he> who is handsomer than I am; a. e.—Pl. <he>שַׁפִּירָן</he>, <cite ref="U01762"><he>שַׁפִּירָתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 6:1">Targ. Y. ib. 1</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 42:15">Targ. Job XLII, 15</cite>; a. e.

senses.gloss: (adv.) right, well. B. Mets. l. c. אטו … דש׳ קאמינא do I not know that what I say is right? Yoma 29ᵇ מאן קא מותיב ש׳ קא מותיב he who asked that question has asked well.
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 94b:6">Yeb. 94ᵇ</cite> <he>והאי ש׳ נסיב</he> and he married rightly (legally); <he>והא ש׳ נסיב</he> and he married this one lawfully; a. fr.—<he>ש׳ דמי</he>, v. <cite ref="D00892"><he>דְּמֵי</he> I</cite>.
